damage_assessments.privacy: address, parcel, owner-value and structure-detail fields are not requested or stored

limitations: County 'Preplan' polygons never listed in the order matrix are kept only in raw/ (labels in preplan_labels_not_packaged).
Zone polygons come from County-hosted operational layers; their attributes (EvacStatus, dates, Population ranks) are not used because the hosted layers were edited after their stated times.
Zone 6r and 'Unnamed' are the 10/30 revision of Zone 6 and its City of Santa Rosa carve-out (blank label, EvacID 340).
Zones 1B, 1C, 3C and 5B were later reduced; the packaged polygon is the first one published for that label.
The Oct 23 Geyserville order targets the Census Designated Place; its polygon is the TIGER 2018 CDP boundary.
The County adopted Zonehaven evacuation zones after 2019; these are not those zones.

fire_detections.note: All detections in the package bbox and dates are kept; not every detection belongs to the Kincade Fire.

fire_perimeters.note: FEDS starts 2019-10-24 00:00 local (07:00Z), about 2.5 h after ignition; no NIST-style reconstruction exists for Kincade.

notes: TIGER/Line geometry is NAD83 longitude/latitude, used as OGC:CRS84 (sub-metre difference).
ACS values are survey estimates with 90% MOEs; MOEs of derived sums are not computed.
ACS 2014-2018 was released after the fire; it describes the pre-fire resident population.
population.selection: TIGER 2018 block groups whose bounding box overlaps the package bbox (so totals exceed the evacuated area)

limitations: OSM is community mapped and may omit roads or 2019 access restrictions.
Service roads were not requested; private/no-access ways are excluded.
Unknown directional lane counts and speeds remain null.
Exit nodes are geometric boundary crossings; destination names are labelled only for state/US routes.
Overpass attic data reflects the OSM history as served by the mirror, not a verified 2019 ground survey.

notes: Workbook times are wall-clock local; converted with PDT (UTC-7), inferred from diurnal minimum and order-time peaks.
flow_veh = sum of per-lane hourly rates x 300/3600 (derived); per-lane rates are kept only in the raw workbook.
T columns are the workbook's per-lane averages; density and vehicle length were computed by the dataset authors.
pct_observed (PeMS imputation share) is not in the dataset; detector_health_pct is the dataset's health field.
Station points are derived from Caltrans SHN postmile points by matching printed absolute postmile to Caltrans odometer (assumed equivalent).
Routine days are weekend days only (Sat/Sun of ISO weeks 39-42), matching the paper's design.
